question: Laser' is a category of which of the following sports at the Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sailing.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Laser is a class of single-handed, one-design sailing dinghies usually seen in the Olympic Games.**
 
• Bruce Kirby designed the Laser in 1970.
 
• Lasers are **hard, physical boats to sail.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Nethra Kumanan** becomes the** first Indian woman sailor to qualify for Tokyo Olympics.**
 
• She **qualified for the Tokyo Olympics in the laser radial class **of the Asian Olympic qualification championships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Equestrian**

 
 
• ​Sports that use **horses as a main part of the sport. **
 
• An** example** of an equestrian is** a polo player.**
 
• The current Olympic **equestrian events are Dressage, Eventing, and Jumping.**
 
• In each discipline, both individual and team medals are awarded.
 
 
 
• **Golf**
 
 
• ​Golf is a** club-and-ball sport** in which** players use various clubs to hit balls into a series of holes** on a course in as few strokes as possible.
 
• **Golf returned to the Olympics in 2016, for the first time since 1904.**
 
• 60 players qualified for each event, which consisted of a 72-hole individual stroke play tournament, played over four days.
 
 
 
• **Fencing**
 
 
• ​Fencing began the move from a form of military training to a sport in either the 14th or 15th century. 
 
• It is a kind of Sword Play.
 
• **Fencing was included for the first time at the 1896 Games in Athens.**
 
• The** women's fencing competition **entered the Games in **1924 in Paris. **
